reviewing.title: This campaign is under review.
reviewing.description: Our team is reviewing the campaign. If changes are needed, cancel the approval request and edit the campaign.

rejected.description: Check the rejection reasons, revise the marked items, and request re-approval.

reReviewing.title: This campaign is under re-review.
reReviewing.description: Our team is reviewing the revised campaign. If changes are needed, cancel the approval request and edit the campaign. (Up to 2 times)

approved.description: You can check the confirmed campaign information.

dev.label: Dev review switch

cancel.title: Cancel approval request
cancel.description: If you cancel the approval request, your payment will be refunded and the campaign will return to the draft state. Pay again after editing to resubmit.

reapproval.title: Re-approval requested.
reapproval.description: Your changes will be sent to our team again. You can run the campaign once it is approved.

error.failed: The request failed. Please try again later.
